note: Triennial election of Newry No. 2 (County Armagh) Rural District Council, twenty-nine single-member divisions, 1949. Nominations were received by W. B. O'Donoghue, returning officer; five contests were threatened but four took place, polled Thursday 2 June 1949. There was no nomination for Drumintee, whose outgoing member was deemed re-elected. Labels as printed in the Newry Telegraph. Polled Thursday 2 June 1949. Devlin was the outgoing member.
